items.title: Trump Threatens a “Tremendous Tax” on Companies That Build Data Centers Overseas
items.summary: Trump promised a punishing penalty for overseas data centers, yet named no rate, no date, and no company, and his own staff hadn't heard the plan. Five stocks sank anyway, and one of them faces a risk the others don't.

items.title: Inside George Soros’s Portfolio: Every Move He Made in the Third Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSoros Fund Management’s latest 13F shows Intel as its largest US stock at Sept. 30, after the fund grew the stake more than 28x in the third quarter.

items.title: DLR Boosts Frankfurt Data Center Capacity With New Power Connection
items.summary: Digital Realty adds a dedicated 110-kV power connection delivering up to 300 MVA to support Frankfurt campus expansion and evolving customer needs.

items.title: Steve Eisman Says the Biggest AI Risk Is Local Governments Slowing Data Center Construction
items.summary: Steve Eisman says the real threat to AI is not chips but zoning boards, and a full freeze could tip the country into recession overnight. One kind of company could still profit if building slows, and it may surprise you.

items.title: Why Equinix and Digital Realty Benefit From Data Center Zoning Battles
items.summary: New data center zoning restrictions and rising construction costs are boosting pricing power for established operators Equinix and Digital Realty, which posted record third-quarter bookings.

items.title: A $43 Billion Fund Dumps These 2 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElement Capital, a firm managing $43. 43 billion, sold all of its SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) and Digital Realty (DLR:NYSE) shares in the Q3, its latest 13F shows.

items.title: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting Digital Realty Trust Stock Will Climb or Sink?
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust has outpaced the broader market over the past year, and analysts remain highly optimistic about the stock's prospects.

items.title: Want $7,000 in Passive Income? Buy These 3 Dividend Stocks Today
items.summary: Selling shares to pay the bills can wreck a retirement portfolio in a downturn. A biotech giant, a Coca-Cola bottler, and a Kansas utility offer another route, though one of them carries a payout ratio above its own target.
